clauses.rule: split first hyphen or equals; left origin, right destination; preserve slash literals

engineeringRules.inheritRoute: within active header region; merged route blanks inherit previous route
engineeringRules.styles: record hidden/struck/invisible values; retain because note specifies no exclusion
engineeringRules.postprocess: fields-v002: trim strings, price number normalization, 40GP/40HQ fallback, ETD and validity relations; unrelated legacy global handlers excluded
engineeringRules.unknownRequiredRules: prevent consistency success when not independently checked
engineeringRules.contextScope: Explicit 共享说明 applies to all regions on that sheet; currency, units and other context are local to the declared next table; ambiguous scope requires review.
engineeringRules.extractionComparison: Compare canonical field projections using the frozen field rules. Equivalent price/date/container/remark normalization may occur during extraction or postprocessing; original source facts and actual raw output remain separately archived.
